Horizon is an unofficial Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 client written in Rust. It contains none of Minecraft\'s code, textures or sounds, so it prepares those from your own copy of the game.\n\nOn a computer, prepare the resources with horizon-prepare (see docs/android.md in the repository), then copy the resulting horizon-resources folder into a ZIP file and import it here. The app keeps its own copy; no computer is needed after this step.
